metadata.name: enrg_profile
metadata.description: ENRG Energy Profile — device metadata and sliding energy window

instructions.name: initialize_profile
docs: Creates the EnergyProfile PDA for the given authority.
Seeds: [b"profile", authority.key().as_ref()]

accounts.name: authority
docs: Profile owner (signs the transaction).

accounts.name: profile
docs: EnergyProfile PDA, created with seeds [b"profile", authority.key().as_ref()].

instructions.name: read_profile
docs: View function to read the profile.
Returns all EnergyProfile fields.

accounts.name: profile
docs: EnergyProfile PDA (read-only).

accounts.name: authority
docs: Authority whose profile is read (not necessarily the signer).

instructions.name: record_production
docs: Records energy production into the device rolling window.
Called via CPI from enrg-mvp on every mint.
Requires the PROFILE OWNER's signature (legacy path, kept for
compatibility; `mint_energy` uses `record_production_authorized`).

accounts.name: authority
docs: Profile owner (authority) — signs the CPI.

accounts.name: profile
docs: EnergyProfile PDA (mut for updating the rolling window).

instructions.name: record_production_authorized
docs: Records production WITHOUT the profile owner's signature.
Used by `enrg-mvp::mint_energy` so an oracle can mint for a device owned by
ANY wallet (the reward goes to `producer.authority`, not to the signer).
Authorization: `caller` MUST be the enrg-mvp `mint-authority` PDA
(`mint_authority_pda()`). That PDA is owned by enrg-mvp, so only enrg-mvp
can sign for it — no third party can move a device's window. Everything
else (device Ed25519 signature, oracle signature, nonce, freshness, policy)
was already validated by `mint_energy` before this CPI.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Must equal the enrg-mvp `mint-authority` PDA (checked in the handler).

accounts.name: authority
docs: Profile owner (NOT a signer) — used only for the PDA seeds.

accounts.name: profile
docs: EnergyProfile PDA (mut for updating the rolling window).

instructions.name: update_metadata
docs: Updates device metadata (rated_power, device_type, location).
Only the profile authority can call it.
M-4: rated_power is IMMUTABLE after the first assignment — the owner
cannot "raise their own mint cap". A change is only possible via a
verification/upgrade procedure (beyond the MVP scope; requires an
upgrade instruction with governance control). The change is recorded
by the RatedPowerChanged event.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Profile owner (signs the transaction).

accounts.name: profile
docs: PDA EnergyProfile.

types.name: EnergyProfile
docs: EnergyProfile — stores device metadata and the rolling energy window.
Seeds PDA: [b"profile", authority.key().as_ref()]

fields.name: authority
docs: Profile owner (authority).

fields.name: device_id
docs: Device ID (from the Device Registry).

fields.name: rated_power
docs: Device rated power (W).

fields.name: device_type
docs: Device type (string up to 32 bytes).

fields.name: location
docs: Location (string up to 64 bytes).

fields.name: device_energy_30d
docs: Rolling energy window for 30 days (Wh).

fields.name: device_energy_updated_at
docs: Time of the last window update.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for the PDA.
